reviews.t: This is the BEST hand cream; have used for 32 years!
reviews.x: I’m 50 & have used this product since college.  Whenever I try a different hand-cream, it’s too “silky” whereas I want something moisturizing that soaks in.  People often compliment how great my hands & elbows look (I use it on both).  An odd compliment, yet it’s a testimony to Avon Moisture Therapy Intensive Healing & Repair! I buy this in bulk so there’s always a tube next to every sink in the house.

reviews.t: Great Avon Product
reviews.x: Purchasing from MAKU STORE you get great service, good price and fast delivery. I purchased through Amazon as I always do on the AVON MOISTURE THERAPY for Intensive Healing & Repair of my dry, cracking skin on my hands. I was a machinist for many years and my hands suffer for it. Avon Moisture Therapy is the ONLY product that works and I tried everything over the last 30 years.

reviews.t: Convenient and Hogh Quality
reviews.x: Have used this product for years but always had to search for a local Avon rep to order the item. Finding it on Amazon was wonderful. I was concerned that it might not be the product I had grown accustomed to, but I am happy to report that it is the same intensive healing lotion as I’ve used in the past. Very pleased!

reviews.t: Great Hand cream
reviews.x: I absolutely LOVE this hand cream!!! My mom sold Avon for 46 years and I got started using this hand cream. She passed away a year ago, so I checked on Amazon to find me some and I was very excited to find it!!!!❤️

reviews.t: The Best
reviews.x: Have used this for yeas, always having one around the house, at the office. Love it has no scent, moisturizes perfectly without needing a lot of lotion. My husband is hooked on it too. He likes it helps the dry hands and keeps them that way till you wash them again. I buy in bulk because my parents and daughter/her family love them too. Great for grandson's dry hands that crack in winter. Was sad when local Avon Outlet closed wondering what where I could get them without having to search for Avo

reviews.t: Great deal, best hand cream ever!
reviews.x: Have been using this product for years, it’s amazing! Overnight it heals cracked dry hands. You don’tneed a lot because it’s somewhat thick and deeply moisturizes. The price on Amazon is great, Avon’s current, regular price is 6.00 a tube, so their price for the same Amazon offer would be 60.00! .I highly recommend giving it a try if you have dry hands or if you are someone who washes hands frequently ie health care professionals, daycare employees, etc. try it.

reviews.t: Avon Moisture Therapy is the best answer to your dry skin needs.
reviews.x: Avon Moisture Therapy is the best available product for extreme dry skin. Ideal for problem dry skin that most often occurs on feet and hands. This product is the best therapy for extreme dry skin at the most reasonable price. If you went to a dermatologist you would end up paying ten fold for a prescription product. Try this first and you will smile.

reviews.t: Best hand lotion
reviews.x: This is the best hand lotion I’ve found. I actually gave some to a mechanic, and to a nurse. Both wear gloves for their profession. Their hands healed quickly after being super dry with cracks. I would recommend this lotion to anyone who is looking for a good lotion that helps heal cracked and dry hands

reviews.t: Best hand moisturerizer
reviews.x: Over 25 years ago my hands became very dry during a bad winter, and I cannot tell you how many hand creams I tried before finding this one. I love it. A little goes a long way and while it is not a light creamy consistency this does work. My husband loves it also.

reviews.t: Simply the best
reviews.x: Best hand cream on the market. A little goes a long way but your hands feel great hours after applying. I have tried so many before finding this product. And another plus....no heavy perfume. Don't think it even has a scent. All the better.

reviews.t: Finally something that works on dry itchy skin!!!
reviews.x: Excellent on my dry skin. Moisture lasts for days even between showers. I had searched years and was surprised that my mom had been using Avon Moisture Therapy most of my life. Who knew?

reviews.t: The best hand cream in the world
reviews.x: The best hand cream in the world. Have been using it for about 20years and have never had eczema again. Colleen.

reviews.t: Must have for dry skin
reviews.x: Have been using this product for over 20 yrs.  Soothes dry skin and heals at the same time.

reviews.t: The Only Body Lotion You Will Ever Need!
reviews.x: When a friend commented on my skin, I sent her a case!  She is thrilled.

reviews.t: good value, good product
reviews.x: best hand lotion ever used moisturizes hands stays on good

reviews.t: Crema para las manos de Avon.
reviews.x: Conozco y uso esta crema desde hace 20 anos. La recomiendo con toda seguridad para las manos mas agrietadas, inmediatamente sentiran alivio y se acabarara la resequedad, la piel la absorbe en poco tiempo. Cuando la uses en la noche al acostarte, a la manana siguiente cuando te mojes las manos ahi la sentiras. 100 % garantizada, la mejor crema de manos sin fragancia que puedas conocer.

reviews.t: Love this stuff!!! So glad I found it again.
reviews.x: Have your hands ever been so dry they crack,peel and bleed? And they just hurt. I'm a nurse and washing your hands is part of the job.  Well this is the BEST product. I have been using in for almost 20 years. I slather it on at night before bed and let my skin drink it in, it takes a minute or 2. When I use it during the day, I can get several hand washing before reapplying.

reviews.t: Easily the best intensive repair hand cream.
reviews.x: Have used this hand cream for twenty years because it is not only reasonably priced, it is simply the best. Used conservatively with about a dime sized amount of lotion every night before bed, I never ever have chapped hands, and I am a very frequent hand washer. In winter months, a little extra dollop worked in after the first will heal chapped hands usually overnight.

reviews.t: Best product out there for dry hands
reviews.x: Best product for dry hands ever! Feels a little greasy initially going on but once you get it rubbed in, it’s fine. I love Cetaphil cream too, but this product is better and last longer. I have a tube in the car, at my desk, in my nightstand, and of course bathroom & kitchen.  I give it as a gift too.

reviews.t: Your hands will thank you!!!
reviews.x: I battle eczema and this hand cream is the most effective that I've found. Super excited that I found it on Amazon and in this quantity and price. You will not be disappointed! I have given them out of gifts. A tube lasts a long time given the small amount that's needed for each use.

reviews.t: Good Cream, but one defective tube
reviews.x: I love this Avon hand cream.  The shipment arrived promptly and box was not damaged. However, one of tubes arrived oozing and leaking from the crimp on the end.  I would appreciate another tube be sent to replace it.  Left feedback requesting another tube, never contacted by seller.

reviews.t: Good product, but one Hand Cream container had pinhole
reviews.x: I don't often write reviews but this deserves one. It's a good product and bought it for my mom, but one hand cream containers had a pinhole and some of the cream seeped out in the package and smeared other three containers.  Found the one that looked used and sealed it.

reviews.t: Best Product EVER
reviews.x: I have always loved this product as it has literally SAVED my skin many a winter. You literally can't beat this price either. Thanks so much for delivering all 10 products in such a short amount of time. (They even arrived early :)

reviews.t: the Blistex lip med is way better.
reviews.x: They changed the formula in these or something.  I've used Avon since the 70's but have noticed the products are not the same anymore.  I had to switch to another brand of chap stick, the Blistex lip med is way better.

reviews.t: A lotion that works!
reviews.x: This is a wonderful product! Especially for people who wash their hands a lot. My husband uses this everyday & has had several people complement how nice his hands are, he is a maintenance electrician.

claims.text: Reviewers widely describe it as the best hand cream they have used, often after trying many other products.
Many reviewers have used the product for years or decades, some for 20-30+ years.
It is praised for deeply moisturizing and healing dry, cracked, or itchy skin, including overnight results.
Reviewers note that a little goes a long way because the formula is thick and long-lasting.
Several reviewers appreciate that it has little to no scent or heavy perfume.
